content.comment_body: I’m looking for assistance with setting a counter to a specific value, from a few hundred up to 35,000. I can do this within [product_name] software and have it count down to zero, but I’m not sure how to enter the value easily from a [product_name] panel. The model isn’t critical as I can purchase a new one if necessary. Thanks in advance. [user_name]

Hello. You can adjust the counter’s value in the block parameters. This is possible when working with both [product_name] and its associated panel. To do this, go through the menu and set your parameters. However, since all blocks are shown in this tab, it’s more convenient if you hide blocks you don’t need in the [product_name] software.
Hi, see if the following is helpful to your situation:

Thanks for replying. I already have a working counter, though your method is simpler. What I need now is a foolproof way to set the preset value. Is it possible to fully simulate the [product_name] panel in software, or do I need to buy the actual hardware for testing?
Hello [user_name], you can use the simulation mode in the [product_name] software to simulate the panel operation.
If you need password protection for changing parameters, there are application examples available to help set this up. I hope this information is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants a straightforward method for setting a preset value on a counter directly from a [product_name] panel, spanning a wide value range. Adjustments are easily managed in [product_name] software via simulation and parameter editing. However, the direct method through the panel lacks user-friendliness, especially for less technical or everyday users. There’s also a need for simple and secure (password-protected) access, highlighting limitations in both interface design and security for real-world parameter adjustments.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to securely and effortlessly enter any preset counter value using the [product_name] panel, and to have complete simulation capabilities for panel operation within [product_name] software, without needing physical hardware.
